pending.body: BiologySnapshot struct in crates/tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs (line 144-162) is missing the sub_adult_count field. TankSnapshot now has sub_adult_count (snapshot.rs:39) and it's populated from state.animal.sub_adult.count (snapshot.rs:138), but the /biology API endpoint silently omits sub-adults. Add `pub sub_adult_count: u32` to BiologySnapshot and populate it from `s.sub_adult_count` in get_biology().

The conductivity calculation in crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs:174 uses a bare magic number 0.65 (`self.tds_mg_per_l(volume_l) / 0.65`). Per the project prompt's requirement that 'conversion factors should be defined as named constants, not magic numbers scattered through rendering code', this should be a named constant (e.g., `const TDS_TO_CONDUCTIVITY_FACTOR: f64 = 0.65;`) with a doc comment explaining its derivation and limitations.

The chemistry_field_semantics metadata (snapshot.rs:100-112) only documents the new-style field names. It should also document `do_mg_l` and `do_sat_mg_l` (which appear in the chemistry response at lines 57-58) since these lack the explicit unit suffix pattern used by other fields and could be confused with dissolved organic matter.

The GH/KH conversion constants in water.rs (lines 5-6, and the inline coefficients 2.497 and 4.118 at line 162) are bare magic numbers without documentation of their chemical derivation. Like the N/P conversion factors in conversions.rs, these should be named constants with doc comments explaining the molar mass ratios they represent (Ca²+ equivalent weight → CaCO3, Mg²+ equivalent weight → CaCO3).

`snapshot_response_json()` only backfills legacy aliases for TAN/NH3/NO2/NO3/PO4/TDS/conductivity in `crates/tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs:86-96`, but `TankSnapshot` also renamed `dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_l` to `dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_c_per_l` in `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:20-21`. As a result, `/snapshot`, `/time/step`, `/load`, and scenario-load responses no longer contain the old DIC key, so pre-rename API clients that deserialize the old snapshot shape will fail even though the other renamed fields were kept backward-compatible. Add the missing top-level `dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_l` alias and include it in `legacy_chemistry_aliases`.

`OMITTED_TDS_CONTRIBUTORS` in `crates/tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs:9-12` says the 7-ion estimate omits "untracked nitrogen and phosphorus ions". That is false for this model: TAN/NH3, nitrite, nitrate, and phosphate are tracked and surfaced in the same response; they are merely excluded from the TDS/conductivity proxy. Reword this metadata to say those tracked species are omitted from the estimate, otherwise the new self-description still misstates model scope and can mislead users about what the simulation actually tracks.

`crates/tank_tui/src/screens/chemistry.rs:51-59` and `crates/tank_tui/src/screens/overview.rs:49-58` stop at `Est. TDS (7-ion)` / `Est. conductivity`, but never tell the TUI user which seven ions are counted or that nitrate/phosphate/organics are excluded. The API now carries that scope metadata, so the UI portion of this bead is still incomplete: a TUI user cannot actually tell what the estimate includes or omits, which was part of the acceptance criteria for the chemistry-semantics change.
